All India AYUSH Post Graduate Entrance Test (AIAPGET)

The National Testing Agency (NTA) conducts the All India AYUSH Post Graduate Entrance Test (AIAPGET) for admission to postgraduate courses in Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy. Candidates should read the Information Bulletin carefully before filling in the online application form.

Eligibility, the examination scheme, the syllabus and the important dates are given in the Information Bulletin published on this website. Candidates are advised to visit the official website regularly for public notices and updates.
